statement: Let (M4, g, K) be a smooth connected orientable exterior, complete with its nonempty compact smooth boundary included, and with exactly one Euclidean coordinate end and compact complement. Assume g − δ = O2(r−q ), K = O1(r−1−q ), q > 1. Use the four-dimensional densities and ADM normalizations of Section 8. Suppose the densities are integrable, the finite ADM charges satisfy E > |P|, the dominant energy condition holds, and the boundary satisfies H + trtan K ≤ 0 with normal into M.
